objects.description: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) retrieves browser histories via infostealer malware such as Raccoon Stealer.(Citation: CISA Scattered Spider Advisory November 2023)
objects.description_fa: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) تاریخچه مرورگر را از طریق بدافزار infostealer مانند Raccoon Stealer بازیابی می‌کند.(Citation: CISA Scattered Spider Advisory November 2023)
